product.description: Monoprice™USB 2.0 USB-A to USB-C Silicone Cable, 3ft / 6ft / 10ft, Charge& Sync, 480Mbps Data, Soft-Touch Flexible JacketThe Monoprice USB 2.0 USB-A to USB-C Silicone Cable is an everyday charge-and-sync cable that replaces the stiff PVC cable packaged with most phones and tablets. The silicone jacket stays flexible at room temperature and resists the permanent bends and creases that develop in lower-cost cables. It charges phones, tablets, controllers, and small accessories from any standard USB-A port and syncs data at the USB 2.0 rate, which covers phone-to-laptop transfers, controller updates, and wired Android™ Auto.Built around length-optimized conductor gauges so charging performance holds up across the longer runs. The 3ft cable uses 24AWG power conductors and a 4.25mm outer diameter; the 6ft cable steps up to 22AWG; and the 10ft cable uses 20AWG with a slightly larger 4.6mm jacket. In factory inspection, each length held conductor voltage drop under 500mV on Vbus. No drivers, no setup.Aluminum connector shells with gold-plated contact pins. Reinforced TPE strain relief at each end resists the wiggle-induced contact wear that breaks down lower-cost cables.Four jacket colors (Black, White, Blue, Gray) and three lengths (3ft, 6ft, 10ft).
